description: Read the caller's Thread.Queue contents on demand (freesoexperiment-dbe). Perception broadcasts the queue every tick via the ActionQueue block, but this verb gives a precision read right after a mutation (queue-interactions, cancel-interaction, build batch) before the next perception fires. Useful for learning the action_uids that queue-interactions assigned (those UIDs aren't in queue-interactions' response — engine assigns them in EnqueueAction when the PDU runs server-side). Response: {count, queue:[{action_uid, name, interaction_id, callee_id, callee_kind, callee_guid_hex, mode, priority, param0, status}]}. action_uid is the cancellation handle (q.UID); interaction_id is the TTAB index (q.InteractionNumber) — they are distinct. status is 'running' for entry 0 (currently executing) and 'queued' for the rest.

args.name: include_idle
args.description: When false, filters out VMQueueMode.Idle engine-autopilot entries so the agent sees only deliberate actions. Default true.

common_mistakes: Confusing action_uid (cancellation handle, what cancel-interaction wants) with interaction_id (TTAB index, what interact-with wants).

Reading the queue immediately after queue-interactions and being surprised it's not yet populated — the PDUs go through VMNetDriver.InternalTick on the next server tick; perception lag is ~1s. If urgent, re-query after a short delay; otherwise wait for the next perception frame.
Forgetting that 'running' (entry 0) is also IN the queue — the head entry is the currently-executing one; queue.length=0 means truly idle.
perception_hints: Most of the time perception's ActionQueue block is fresh enough — use this verb only when you've just mutated the queue and can't wait for the next tick.
Use --include_idle false when you want to know 'has the prefrontal-loop given the body anything to do', filtering out lizard-brain autonomy entries.
Combine with queue-interactions: dispatch the batch, query-action-queue to read assigned UIDs, then cancel-interaction by UID if you need to drop a specific one later.
